identity.person_root: Membership consumes an existing Person (person_public_id); it never creates a Person and never writes people.unit_id or person_unit_contexts

codes.MEMBERSHIP_VIEW: list, search (name, official number, legacy), detail, periods, milestones, legacy identifiers, visible transfers
codes.MEMBERSHIP_APPROVE: approve (individual or collective) -> number; reject; readmit
codes.MEMBERSHIP_MANAGE: inactivate, reactivate, end; record and correct milestones

permissions.rule: permission + active UNIT scope covering the Congregation of the OPEN period (TerritorialAuthority data_type MEMBERSHIP); permission never grants scope; public_id/URI never grants anything

member_number.aa_mm: Africa/Luanda civil year/month of the approval instant that issues it; issued_at stored in UTC
member_number.ssssss: national continuous counter MEPA_NATIONAL, never reset, never recycled, 999999 fails closed
member_number.issued_only_by: the approval transaction (individual = collective list of one)

collective_approval.lock_order: Persons then memberships by ascending id, counter last
collective_approval.audit: one row per membership, one shared correlation_id

periods.invariant: exactly one open period per membership (uq_membership_periods_membership_open); memberships.status_id = open period status; contiguous history; commit-time recheck

stage_authority.reject: origin while REQUESTED, destination while ORIGIN_VALIDATED

transfers.completion: atomic: re-validate DESTINATION_ACCEPTED, Person, ACTIVE membership, origin = open period, ACTIVE destination; close origin period at T, open destination period at T, close transfer, complete workflow; member_numbers untouched; replay = no-op
transfers.visibility: both parties see the transfer row, also after completion; the membership follows the open period

documents.authority: Membership decision first, then FilesConsumers::documentAuthority (DOCUMENTS_VIEW + scope over owner unit + clearance + ACTIVE)
documents.projection: public_id only with Files authority, otherwise has_document

errors.404: RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, byte-identical for unknown, malformed, out-of-scope, wrong Congregation, transfer outside authority, document failures
errors.403: FORBIDDEN: permission not held anywhere (decided before resolving the target)

search.scope: SQL filter over covered units before pagination
search.out_of_scope: empty list identical to not existing
search.audit: membership.lookup for official-number / legacy lookups (kind, term, scoped result count)

audit.unit: the authorizing unit; other units as public ids in metadata

ui.principle: hiding a button is usability only; the backend decides every request
